payload.body:
0106's design note read: sound, go for the bytes in your own worktree off main's head (name the base). vc's calls:
1. The lib: yes. opt/menuz/lib/launch-services.sh, sourced by menuz and by cmd/macos from $ROOT; 0104's APP_LSREGISTER, app_lsregister, app_records_under and the mirror guard test go. The shared fake helper under opt/menuz/test/ too, loaded by both suites.
4. (a): the exit stands, with the warning naming the bundle and the command that drops it by hand. The warning is the surfacing.
6. No real install in the booked run; your own XDG_STATE_HOME as you say.
7. Dev launch: leave it (dev selected, Debug by path is what was asked); say so in the usage text. The doctor line: yes, read-only, WARN naming each record for the id at a path other than the installed app, with the lsregister -u line to drop it; one bats test each way on the fakes. hv's three stale records: vc drops them after the landing (hv's 'yes, fix' is for the id to resolve to the installed app), with reads before and after by the id; not yours. cc-wp06's dir: leave it.
Docs and CHANGELOG as you list. Shellcheck 0.9.0 and 0.11.0 on every changed script. Send the SHAs and the net sha256; then the fakes run and the real run, each booked through vc with molt-vc. No push.
